> Superseded by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/20034 after the Ascend overlay source migration in recipes#1160 and vllm-ascend#19381. The shared/core GLM-5.1 recipe stays in vLLM; Ascend-only content is now proposed in vLLM-Ascend. Renderer/schema support remains in https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/pull/1163.



## Overview

Add documented Ascend A3/950DT deployment configurations to the existing GLM-5.1 recipe, preserving its NVIDIA/AMD configuration and Guide.

**Blocked by https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/pull/1163.** This draft uses that renderer's named-script schema. Merge and publish the renderer/schema first; the current `Recipes` check against renderer `main` is expected to reject these new fields until then. This PR does not change or bypass that workflow.

## Claims

- Add hardware-scoped A3 W8A8 and 950DT MXFP4 variants, container preparation, Ascend parser/MTP overrides, and fixed documented topologies.
- Provide A3 two-node colocated serving and both four-node PD workflows in the upper command builder: complete node templates, separate start commands, shared role-appropriate launchers and Ascend Proxy configuration.
- Maintain scripts once in `deployment_scripts`, not as positional Guide code blocks. The concise Ascend Guide retains prerequisites, exact checkpoint links, scope/compatibility notes and fixed-revision source references.
- Preserve the existing GPU variants, common model configuration and GPU Guide. No new `verified` badge or runtime-performance claim is added.

## Validation

Using the renderer from recipes PR #1163 (`37fe0cae2866e413947c2d6b34ad58c852b12215`):

```bash
# From the recipes renderer checkout, with this PR's vllm checkout:
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir /path/to/vllm/recipes

# Using an assembled tree containing this recipe:
RECIPES_CONTENT_DIR=<assembled-tree> node --test \
  scripts/test-schema.mjs scripts/test-overlay.mjs \
  scripts/test-scripted-strategies.mjs scripts/test-smg-pd.mjs \
  scripts/test-dcp-selector.mjs

# From the vllm checkout:
git diff origin/main --check
pre-commit run --files recipes/models/zai-org/GLM-5.1.yaml
```

- Renderer schema/overlay/command tests: **47/47 passed**. The strict `validate-source.mjs` flow passed in WSL against this checkout and renderer #1163: source fetching, three-source assembly, schema checking and API generation for **215 recipes**. The initial native Windows attempt hit a generated-tree symlink permission error; the WSL run completed successfully without changing the validation workflow.
- Full pre-commit is **not reported as passed**: the configured package index could not provide `setuptools>=40.8.0` while bootstrapping the `typos` hook. A process-local retry against the official PyPI index remained in dependency installation for over four minutes and was interrupted; no recipe changes were made by the hooks. `git diff origin/main --check` passed.
- Mocked Bash/Python checks covered all A3/950DT P0/P1/D0/D1 templates and launcher interfaces, device/rank assignment, engine IDs, working directories, service ports and proxy backend order. A3's headless P1 is not registered as an HTTP endpoint. Checks did not start NPU engines.
- Script-storage regression: **192 comparisons** across both PD presets, both nodes/roles, populated/empty endpoints and removed/changed/reordered Guide content; common preparation/proxies, two colocated commands, two native Ascend commands and **112 existing GPU command combinations** remained equivalent.
- Browser checks on the existing local development server covered node/hardware switching, endpoints, displayed/copied templates and launch commands, common launchers, Docker preparation, native prerequisites, colocated nodes and remaining Guide anchors. No dev-server restart or production build was used for this validation.
- **No new NPU inference, accuracy, throughput, full-context or Rust-on-Ascend evaluation was performed or claimed.** This is a recipe/documentation migration, not an engine/model implementation change. Deployment evidence comes from the referenced tutorial/publisher examples; the requester explicitly asked not to rerun hardware tests.

## Details

Source: [vllm-ascend GLM5 tutorial, e5e820d5c935e6197bec8bc13e8e8936eb2740d0](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/e5e820d5c935e6197bec8bc13e8e8936eb2740d0/docs/source/tutorials/models/GLM5.md).

| Workflow | Checkpoint / topology |
| --- | --- |
| A3 native single-node | `Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w8a8`, TP16, 66,600 tokens; publisher reference, not the tutorial's W4A8 settings |
| 950DT native single-node | `Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a4c8-mxfp4`, TP8, 202,752 tokens, FP8 attention/indexer KV |
| A3 colocated | `Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP`, two nodes, global DP8/local DP4/TP4 |
| A3 PD | Same W8A8/C8-MTP checkpoint; Prefill PP2/TP16 with layers 41/37, Decode DP8/TP4 with four local ranks per node |
| 950DT PD | MXFP4/FP8-KV; two independent TP8 Prefill services, Decode DP16/TP1 with eight local ranks per node |

A3 Prefill runs Bash directly; Decode uses its eight-argument launcher including PP size. All four 950DT nodes use a separate seven-argument launcher. Docker images/device maps/mounts and proxy ports are hardware-specific. These are fixed configurations, not support claims for arbitrary precision/topology combinations.

The Guide records migration differences: nested configuration keys/checkpoint-path corrections, unique engine IDs, string RPC-port arguments/defaults and child-failure propagation; the A3 publisher single-node option-name mapping; and normalizing both 950DT Decode contexts to 135,000 tokens to match Prefill. W8A8C8 describes W8A8 weights plus cache quantization; published checkpoint identifiers are preserved.

**Duplication check:** searched open vllm PRs for GLM-5.1/GLM recipe and Ascend recipe work; no open PR addressing this recipe migration was found. recipes #1040 is related single-node work in the renderer repository, while this PR uses the current owning source repository and includes the fixed PD/colocated configurations. No tracking issue was supplied. No core runtime, CI configuration, generated API files or research records are changed.

+  - **950DT:** [Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a4c8-mxfp4](https://modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a4c8-mxfp4),
+    MXFP4 weights, FP8 attention/indexer KV cache, TP8, 202,752 tokens.
+
+  Run Docker on the host using the upper preparation block, then run the service
+  command inside that container. On 950DT, fill LOCAL_IP and NIC_NAME in the upper
+  container-environment block first. Select the Python frontend. MTP is opt-in for
+  single-node serving; tool calling uses glm47 and reasoning uses glm45.
+
+  ### A3 multi-node colocated
+
+  Use **W8A8 (A3)** and **Multi-node colocated**: two nodes, global DP8, local DP4,
+  TP4, [Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP](https://modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP)
+  and int8 attention/indexer KV cache. Prepare Docker on each host, then select
+  Node 0 or Node 1 above and fill its IP, NIC and checkpoint path before executing
+  the corresponding command inside its container. This is a fixed topology.
+
+  ### Prefill-Decode prerequisites
+
+  Install the [Mooncake transfer prerequisites](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.html)
+  inside each container. Both presets use **MooncakeConnectorV1**, not NIXL or
+  the separate Mooncake KV-offload/store configuration. The source presents PD as
+  a reference design, not a production recommendation.
+
+  Common preparation above shows Docker (host), then the matching complete launcher.
+  Save the Python file as /root/glm51-pd/launch_online_dp.py only on the nodes listed
+  there. Select Prefill/Decode and node 0/1, save its run_dp_template.sh in the same
+  directory, then copy the separate launch command. Fill Cluster endpoints or edit
+  the explicit local placeholders; no shared cluster-variable export is required.
+  Do not place a launcher command inside the template it invokes.
+
+  The **Ascend Proxy** tab prepares its pinned script only on the proxy node and
+  lists the actual HTTP backends. Use a free proxy port: 8000 conflicts with the
+  A3 APIs on P0, D0 and D1; the headless P1 is not an HTTP backend.
+  Use the upper cURL/Bench after all engines are ready (proxy for PD, Node 0 for
+  colocated). These fixed deployments serve the alias glm-5.1; single-node commands
+  use the selected checkpoint ID instead.
+
+  ### A3 Prefill-Decode disaggregation
+
+  Use [Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP](https://modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w8a8c8-MTP):
+  two Prefill nodes form one PP2/TP16 engine with layers 41/37; Decode is DP8/TP4,
+  four local ranks per node. P0/P1 execute Bash directly; only D0/D1 use the
+  eight-argument launcher (including --pp-size). P0 exposes port 8000, P1 is
+  headless; each Decode node exposes 8000–8003. Migrated templates retain the
+  corrected checkpoint path, nested configuration keys and unique Decode engine IDs.
+
+  ### 950DT Prefill-Decode disaggregation
+
+  Use [Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a4c8-mxfp4](https://modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a4c8-mxfp4):
+  MXFP4 weights and FP8 KV cache, two independent TP8 Prefill services (DP1 each),
+  Decode DP16/TP1 with eight local ranks per node. All four nodes use the separate
+  seven-argument launcher (no --pp-size). Prefill uses 6700; each Decode node uses
+  6721–6728. The migration sets 135,000 tokens on both Decode nodes to match Prefill
+  instead of the source's differing Decode lengths.
+
+  Both launchers keep RPC ports as strings and propagate child failures. The builder
+  restricts these presets to their documented checkpoint/topology; it does not
+  validate arbitrary precision or pool-size combinations. Static command checks
+  are not new NPU inference, accuracy, throughput or full-context validation.
+
+  ## Deployment references
+
+  See the fixed tutorial for [A2 deployment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/e5e820d5c935e6197bec8bc13e8e8936eb2740d0/docs/source/tutorials/models/GLM5.md#52-multi-node-deployment),
+  [tuning](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/e5e820d5c935e6197bec8bc13e8e8936eb2740d0/docs/source/tutorials/models/GLM5.md#9-performance-tuning) and [evaluation](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/e5e820d5c935e6197bec8bc13e8e8936eb2740d0/docs/source/tutorials/models/GLM5.md#7-accuracy-evaluation).
+  A2 remains linked because there is no A2 hardware profile in this renderer.
